title: Cosmic Eye Gathering
description: A surreal landscape features a giant glowing eye with a purple pupil floating in a swirling cosmic vortex in the sky, emitting beams of light. Below, a large crowd of people sits in an outdoor amphitheater facing a winding, colorful river that flows through a vibrant purple and orange mountain valley lined with stylized trees and flamingos.
prompt: A surreal fantasy landscape with a massive glowing eye with orange and purple iris floating in a swirling blue and purple cosmic vortex in the sky, casting beams of light down onto a winding colorful river. In the foreground, a large audience sits facing the river in an outdoor setting surrounded by stylized trees with orange and blue leaves, pink flamingos, and purple and orange mountains in the background, vibrant colors, dreamy atmosphere.
